text:
Alex C: DeployBot just flagged a canary failure in eu-west-1 and put the rollout on hold. 5xx spike during model handoff. tagging @Priya M @Jamie (oncall) — are we rolling back or pinning?

DeployBot: Canary failure detected (eu-west-1) — 5xx rate = 6.2% over 10m window. Rollout paused at 40% canary. Details: https://metrics.internal/ci/canary/2754820193

Priya M: Ack. Hold noted. Prefer to avoid full rollback unless required. Can we do a region-scoped pin to the previous model SHA to stop traffic hitting the bad variant?

Jamie (oncall): Looking at logs — a few kernel OOMs during KV-cache deserialization, appears correlated with the new kernel patch in the canary build. If pinning is easy we should do that fast. If pin fails, fallback to targeted rollback.

Mark S: I support targeted pin for eu-west-1 only. Proposed command:
```
/deploy pin --region eu-west-1 --service model-serving --model-sha b7f9c3 --reason "canary 5xx spike"
```
That keeps other regions progressing. Ops, can you approve a change-window move for the remaining rollout?

Liz R: If we pin, please update the release notes + QA checklist so downstream owners don't get false positives. Also adjust the canary alert thresholds temporarily to avoid duplicate alerts. :memo:

Priya M: Ops asked to move the rest of rollout out of today's evening window. Suggested new window: Mon 08:00-10:00 PT. Ops contact @Mark S please confirm.

OpsBot: Change request received. Recording: change-window shift to 2026-03-23T15:00Z-17:00Z (Mon 08:00-10:00 PT). Notifying SRE, Release Manager. Link to incident doc: https://incidents.internal/2754820193/followup

Jamie (oncall): No objections. I'll run the pin now and monitor. If health doesn't return within 5m I'll trigger a rollback.

Alex C: :thumbsup: go ahead. Prioritize safety over speed. Make sure to annotate the rollout and notify customers affected by the eu-west-1 traffic shift.

DeployBot: Executing pin: /deploy pin --region eu-west-1 --service model-serving --model-sha b7f9c3
Estimated completion 180s.

DeployBot: Pin complete. Routing updated, new traffic directed to model b7f9c3 in eu-west-1. Health checks passing. Canary 5xx rate back to 0.4%.

Jamie (oncall): Confirming — CPU/memory stable, KV cache warm, no OOMs in last 6m. Good to reschedule remainder of rollout to Monday.

Alex C: Thanks all. I'll draft the post-incident note and add the pin + reschedule to the release notes. Action items:
- Jamie: add short RCA blurb about kernel OOM correlation (due EOD).
- Liz: update release notes and QA checklist (done before Monday window).
- Priya/Mark: confirm ops readiness Monday morning.

Mark S: Confirmed. Ops will be on standby Mon 08:00 PT.

Alex C: Closing thread for now. Will reopen if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
